etymology.historical_story: FamilySearch, citing the Dictionary of American Family Names, records Eirick as a surname and tentatively connects it with North German Wirich or Wierich. That proposal concerns a surname, not a Malay lexical root. Without the original sentence or the name bearer’s history, it cannot establish the origin or pronunciation of this particular token. [Source](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=Eirick)
